automated_tests.skip_reason: Windows foreground lock held by another active app; test refuses to send input or steal focus. Not counted as passed.
automated_tests.deduplication: 1625 initial passes + 2 desktop recheck passes + 19 newly collected visible-client tests. The 9 existing multi-region checks and repeated skip are not added twice.

desktop_recheck.scope: Only the two failed desktop-capture tests and the skipped owned-window movement test, outside the sandbox. No game input or administrator/UAC elevation.

features.visible_client_and_selection_clipping: 28 affected checks passed; 19 new unique cases
features.consistent_paragraph_font: Native synthetic regression: four rows 29 px; original-width character spacing retained
features.vision_geometry: AI text is mapped to measured local anchors; unconfirmed anchors are excluded
features.context_layer: Bounded optional server-side search; independent display-only translation stream

baseline15.definition: 100*(1-Levenshtein distance/reference characters); whitespace removed, Unicode NFKC normalized, curly quotes mapped; case-sensitive.
baseline15.scope: Only the supplied fixed screenshots and manually transcribed zones. OCR character accuracy, not translation semantic accuracy or a general-game success rate.

current25_local.definition: 100*(1-Levenshtein distance/reference characters); whitespace removed, Unicode NFKC normalized, curly quotes mapped; case-sensitive.
current25_local.scope: Only the supplied fixed screenshots and manually transcribed zones. OCR character accuracy, not translation semantic accuracy or a general-game success rate.

space_rogue.scope: Three fixed original Space Rogue screenshots, 356 normalized characters; local OCR in pixel mode for both versions.

japanese_fixed_scene.scope: Single fixed image, source transcription only; not translation semantic accuracy or a general-game guarantee

live_game.limitations: Single quality-assisted scene. Original title Caution remains; OK unchanged. Native submit timing excludes monitor presentation.

timing_comparison.scope: Actual API and GDI, static original image, fresh process and empty DB. Excludes capture, captured-background repair, foreground, DWM, monitor and web context.

legal_notice: Current data-flow explanation includes optional provider-side search.
dependency_note: Existing locked production dependencies and models unchanged; no new external dependency security audit claimed. Experimental tessdata_best model was not adopted or added to production.
schema_validation_note: Release verifier checks inventory, references and hashes. Optional CycloneDX JSON schema validation depends on a separately installed validator.
